caseName: Chemical Manufacturers Ass'n v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Chemical Manufacturers Assn. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc. and United States Environmental Protection Agency v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of Chamber of Commerce of the United States for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 719 F. 2d 624.
